details = {};\r\n\r\n  const add = (key, value) => {\r\n    if (!value) return;\r\n    score += value;\r\n    details[key] = value;\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  const ag = Array.isArray(a.grupos) ? a.grupos : [];\r\n  const bg = Array.isArray(b.grupos) ? b.grupos : [];\r\n\r\n  const ad = Array.isArray(a.dezenas) ? a.dezenas : [];\r\n  const bd = Array.isArray(b.dezenas) ? b.dezenas : [];\r\n\r\n  const ac add(\r\n    \"groupOverlap\",\r\n    new Set(ag.filter(g => bg.includes(g))).size * 6\r\n  );\r\n\r\n  add(\r\n    \"dezenaOverlap\",\r\n    new Set(ad.filter(d => bd.includes(d))).size * 3\r\n  );\r\n\r\n  add(\r\n    \"centenaOverlap\",\r\n    new Set(ac.filter(c => bc.includes(c))).size * 1.5\r\n  );\r\n\r\n  const repA = Array.isArray(a.repeatedGroups) ? a.repeatedGroups.length : 0;\r\n Number(freq.get(g) || 0) / totalWeight : 0);\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  return {\r\n    freq,\r\n    prob,\r\n    samples: ranking.length,\r\n    totalWeight,\r\n  };\r\n}\r\n\r\n\r\n/* =========================\r\n   16/20 milhares (por grupo) — POR TERMINAÇÃO (CORRETO)\r\n========================= */\r\n\r\nfunction getDezenasFixasFromGrupo(grupo2) {\r\n  const g = Number(grupo2);\r\n  if (!Number.isFinite(g) || g < 1 || g > 25) return [];\r\n\r\n  const start = (g - 1) * 4 + 1;\r\n  const out = [];\r\n\r\n  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i += 1) {\r\n    out.push(wrapToDezena2(start + i));\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  return out.filter(Boolean);\r\n}\r\n\r\n\r\nexport function buildMilharesForGrupo({\r\n  rangeDraws,\r\n  analysisHourBucket,\r\n  schedule,\r\n  grupo2,\r\n  count = 20,\r\n  targetYmd = \"\",\r\n}) {\r\n  const list = Array.isArray(rangeDraws) ? rangeDraws : [];\r\n  const target = toHourBucket(analysisHourBucket);\r\n  const schSet = scheduleSet(schedule);\r\n  const targetDay = safeStr(targetYmd);\r\n  const targetDow = isYMD(targetDay) ? getDowKey(targetDay) : null;\r\n\r\n  const N = Number.isFinite(Number(count))\r\n    ?     2:  * Defines High-Resolution Time.
    4:  * The first number, HrTime[0], is UNIX Epoch time in seconds since 00:00:00 UTC on 1 January 1970.
    5:  * The second number, HrTime[1], represents the partial second elapsed since Unix Epoch time represented by first number in nanoseconds.
    6:  * For example, 2021-01-01T12:30:10.150Z in UNIX Epoch time in milliseconds is represented as 1609504210150.
    7:  * The first number is calculated by converting and truncating the Epoch time in milliseconds to seconds:
    8:  * HrTime[0] = Math.trunc(1609504210150 / 1000) = 1609504210.
    9:  * The second number is calculated by converting the digits after the decimal point of the subtraction, (1609504210150 / 1000) - HrTime[0], to nanoseconds:
   10:  * HrTime[1] = Number((1609504210.150 - HrTime[0]).toFixed(9)) * 1e9 = 150000000.
   11:  * This is represented in HrTime format as [1609504210, 150000000].
